ShortDescription.Value: Districts vote on a schedule you set, with turnout and votes driven by who lives there.

Publish.LongDescription: Once your city has a City Hall, it holds elections on a schedule you choose. Every district votes, and turnout and vote choice come from the citizens who actually live there: their age, education, wealth and job. A monthly poll tracks how residents feel about the governing party between elections.
